description: This file defines the RecurringType class which handles recurrence logic for calendar events in the vtiger CRM system, including creation, parsing, and calculation of recurring dates based on various recurrence patterns (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly). It includes methods for constructing recurrence info from user input and database records, and for computing the list of dates on which the event recurs.

classes.name: RecurringType
classes.description: Class responsible for handling event recurrence patterns and calculating recurring dates.

methods.name: RecurringType
methods.description: Constructor initializing recurrence pattern based on input array, setting start/end dates and generating recurrence dates.

methods.name: fromUserRequest
methods.description: Creates a RecurringType instance from user input, converting times to database timezone, and setting recurrence pattern.

methods.name: fromDBRequest
methods.description: Creates a RecurringType instance from database record row, parsing stored recurrence info.

methods.name: getRecurringType
methods.description: Returns the type of recurrence ('Daily', 'Weekly', etc.).

methods.name: getDBRecurringInfoString
methods.description: Returns string representation of recurrence info for database storage.

methods.name: getUserRecurringInfo
methods.description: Returns recurrence info formatted for user display.

methods.name: getDisplayRecurringInfo
methods.description: Returns human-readable details of the recurrence pattern for display.

methods.name: _getRecurringDates
methods.description: Computes and returns the list of dates on which the event recurs, based on pattern.

methods.name: getFistdayofmonth
methods.description: Utility to get the first occurrence of a specific weekday in a month.

methods.name: getLastdayofmonth
methods.description: Utility to get the last occurrence of a specific weekday in a month.
